title: Find users with a phone registered for MFA and what else they have
summary: From the authentication methods registration report: users with mobilePhone registered, their other methods and whether they're admins, to target a passkey campaign.
code:
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'AuditLog.Read.All'

Get-MgReportAuthenticationMethodUserRegistrationDetail -All `
    -Filter "methodsRegistered/any(m:m eq 'mobilePhone')" |
  Select-Object UserPrincipalName, IsAdmin, IsMfaRegistered,
    UserPreferredMethodForSecondaryAuthentication,
    @{n='Methods';e={ $_.MethodsRegistered -join ';' }} |
  Export-Csv .\phone-mfa-users.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
notes: Users whose Methods column holds only mobilePhone (and maybe email) depend on SMS or voice: move them first.
The report reflects registration, not which method was last used for sign-in.

source.label: Move users off SMS and voice MFA before Microsoft-provided SMS and voice retire on 1 February 2027
